definitions: Do not be too critical or ungrateful when receiving a gift or an opportunity.
Accept a gift or an offer without scrutinizing its value or finding fault.
examples: She got a free ticket to the concert, and even though it wasn't her favorite band, she decided not to look a gift horse in the mouth.
They offered him a promotion with a slight pay cut, but he knew not to look a gift horse in the mouth and accepted it.
My neighbor gave me their old car for free; I'm not going to look a gift horse in the mouth by complaining about the color.
lemma: not look a gift horse in the mouth
source: don't look a gift horse in the mouth
